Chapter 5: Linear Regression

data <- read.csv(
  file = "returns.csv",
  sep = ";"
)
data
alior_log_returns <- data$daily_log_returns_alior[-1]
ing_log_returns <- data$daily_log_returns_ing[-1]
plot(alior_log_returns, ing_log_returns)

# install.packages("ggplot2")
# install.packages("ggExtra")
library(ggplot2)
library(ggExtra)
alior_ing <- data.frame(
  alior_log_returns = alior_log_returns,
  ing_log_returns = ing_log_returns
)

p <- ggplot(alior_ing, aes(x = alior_log_returns, y = ing_log_returns)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal()

ggMarginal(p, type = "histogram")

cov(alior_log_returns, ing_log_returns)
[1] 0.0001352158
cor(alior_log_returns, ing_log_returns)
[1] 0.4638365
model <- lm(alior_log_returns ~ ing_log_returns)
summary(model)

Call:
lm(formula = alior_log_returns ~ ing_log_returns)

Residuals:
      Min        1Q    Median        3Q       Max 
-0.061428 -0.006672 -0.000796  0.006681  0.080233 

Coefficients:
                 Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
(Intercept)     0.0009562  0.0005943   1.609    0.108    
ing_log_returns 0.5211673  0.0368928  14.127   <2e-16 ***
---
Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1

Residual standard error: 0.01604 on 728 degrees of freedom
Multiple R-squared:  0.2151,    Adjusted R-squared:  0.2141 
F-statistic: 199.6 on 1 and 728 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16
plot(alior_log_returns, ing_log_returns,
     main = "Regresja liniowa",
     xlab = "Alior log-returns",
     ylab = "ING log-returns",
     pch = 19, col = "darkblue")

abline(model, col = "red", lwd = 2)

alior_ing <- data.frame(
  alior_log_returns = alior_log_returns,
  ing_log_returns   = ing_log_returns
)

p <- ggplot(alior_ing, aes(x = alior_log_returns, y = ing_log_returns)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +   # 👈 tu dodajemy linię regresji
  theme_minimal()

ggMarginal(p, type = "histogram")
